name: hyperpop
eq_intent: Keep intentional brightness while controlling 3 to 9 kHz pain and boxy low-mid buildup.
compression_intent: Forward vocal and energetic bus compression; 2:1 to 6:1 depending on source with attack chosen to keep consonants readable.
de_esser_intent: Vocal-first, 5 to 10 kHz detection, max 4 dB gain reduction with brightness guard.
ms_eq_intent: Protect centered vocal/kick/snare, clean stereo fizz without collapsing synth width.
